text: publish.py's internal-link verification counts only ABSOLUTE urls, so site-relative 'Related reading' links print as '0 internal link(s)' on every push — a false defect signal. Verify internal links via the CMS REST body ('Related reading' present + relative-path count) or the live reader page, never via publish.py's own line.

The reviewer will cut an internal link as 'another vertical's artifact' even though context/internal_links.json links are corpus-wide and same-site links are valid; on a HELD review with hard=0, re-add the link in the hand repair (casebook rule), and re-score the reviewer's re-cut title — the rewrite silently swapped a 100 STRONG headline for a 58 WEAK one.
